species.name: Walleye
why: Water 34°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northwest wind at 8 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
